summary.ru: Герцогство Модена и Реджо — итальянское государство, которое существовало с 1452 по 1859 годы, с перерывом в 1796 и 1814 годах, в период революционных и наполеоновских войн.
summary.en: The Duchy of Modena and Reggio was an Italian state created in 1452 located in Northwestern Italy, in the present-day region of Emilia-Romagna. It was ruled since its establishment by the noble House of Este, and from 1814 by the Austria-Este branch of the family. The Este dynasty was a great sponsor of the arts, making the Duchy a cultural reference during the Renaissance and Baroque periods.
